policy.displayName: Latency SLO: error budget burning fast

documentation.content:
In the last hour half of the queries took more than 500 ms, or half of the CreateOrderPayment calls more than 2 s: 10 times the pace the latency SLOs allow (95% in 30 days). Usually cold starts, a slow dependency (Firestore, Algolia, Stripe) or a slow deploy; the dashboard splits the latency by operation and shows Algolia's apart.

Disabled until the latency limits are confirmed: with today's cold starts the query p95 is above 500 ms, so it would fire all the time. Enable it by setting "enabled" to true and running scripts/applyMonitoring.ts.

What to do: [Runbook](https://roberto-bustos-hernandez.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ARQ/pages/24772610#SLO-y-dashboard).
